func _run_tests() -> void:
	get_tree().paused = false
	var game := await instantiate_scene("res://game.tscn")
	if not check("game", game != null, "La scena game.tscn deve potersi avviare"):
		return
	get_tree().current_scene = game
	var restart_btn := find_by_name(game, "RestartButton") as Button
	var menu_btn := find_by_name(game, "MenuButton") as Button
	if not check("btns", restart_btn != null and menu_btn != null, "Nel menu di pausa devono esserci RestartButton e MenuButton"):
		return
	await tap_action("pause")
	await wait_frames(2)
	check("is_paused", get_tree().paused, "La pausa deve attivarsi correttamente")
	await click_button(restart_btn)
	await wait_frames(4)
	check("restart_unpaused", not get_tree().paused, "Dopo aver premuto Ricomincia get_tree().paused deve essere false")
	var player := find_by_name(get_tree().current_scene, "Player") as Node2D
	if player != null:
		var start_x := player.position.x
		await wait_frames(5)
		check("player_moving", player.position.x != start_x, "Nella partita riavviata il giocatore deve muoversi regolarmente")
	await tap_action("pause")
	await wait_frames(2)
	var current_menu_btn := find_by_name(get_tree().current_scene, "MenuButton") as Button
	if current_menu_btn != null:
		await click_button(current_menu_btn)
		await wait_frames(4)
	check("menu_unpaused", not get_tree().paused, "Tornando al menu principale get_tree().paused deve essere false")
	check("menu_scene", current_scene_path() == "res://menu.tscn", "La scena caricata deve essere res://menu.tscn")
	get_tree().paused = false

func _ready() -> void:

	hide()
	resume_button.pressed.connect(_on_resume_button_pressed)

	menu_button.pressed.connect(_on_menu_button_pressed)


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event.is_action_pressed("pause"):
		if get_tree().paused:
			resume_game()
		else:
			pause_game()

	get_tree().paused = true
	show()


func resume_game() -> void:

	hide()


func _on_resume_button_pressed() -> void:
	resume_game()


func _on_restart_button_pressed() -> void:
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://game.tscn")


func _on_menu_button_pressed() -> void:
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://menu.tscn")
